items.q: Tennessee Ernie had a record on it

ctx.x: Right, that was the early -- about '52. And then -- '51 or '52, what's his name, Tommy Dorsey recorded it, and what's his name sang it, Charlie Shavers, yeah, and then Tennessee Ernie had a record on it, and Jo Stafford had a record, and those --
